role: Field close-up / opposite leaves, stem, and cyathia
creator: UT Austin BIO406D PlantPics
source_context: Exact-species field close-up retained for private visual study; no public reuse claim asserted.

role: Capsule close-up / glabrous fruit with elongated pointed lobes
creator: Nathan Taylor
source_context: Look at the smooth green capsule and its prolonged pointed lobes. This outside view supports capsule shape; an empty internal tip requires dissection and is not proved by this photograph.

role: Leaf pubescence close-up / long soft hairs and smooth capsule
creator: Matt Berger
source_context: Long hairs are conspicuous on the leaves and stem; the capsule beside them is smooth. Hairiness supports identification but does not exclude sparsely hairy E. villifera.

role: Leaf surface close-up / sparsely hairy form and opposite asymmetric leaves
creator: Eric Keith
source_context: Compare this sparsely hairy Bandera plant with the hairy leaf view. Surface texture is visible, but this photograph is not a microscopic verification of individual papillae or stipules.

role: Separated seeds and seed coats / size and shape reference
creator: Carlos Martorell
source_context: Dark seeds and pale/orange seed coats are separated on a palm. Use this for seed context and overall form; do not score fine seed-surface ridges or angles from this image.
